Name: Victorian Furniture - Jewel Set
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55109/55109-1794036068-1366677976.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]This mod adds two gemstone-themed Victorian furniture sets to Stardew Valley.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]

[center][color=#d4d4d8][img width=231]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55109/55109-1794036169-226335017.png[/img][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[color=#d4d4d8]Current Sets Available:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Onyx Set: Black velvets and white marble furniture set.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Ruby Set: Heavy, crimson velvets and black marble furniture set. (Can be toggled off).[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#d4d4d8]Ruby Set can be toggled off or on via:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]The Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) interface in-game.[/color][/*]
[*]The config.json file located in the mod folder.[/*]
[/list]
Requires Content Patcher and Calcifer. GMCM is optional.
[line]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55109/55109-1794036555-787145639.png[/img][/center]
Thank you to Cristina for commissioning the original pieces of this set. Also I want to convey my gratitude to all friends and supporters here at NexusMods, Ko-Fi, Patreon, and Tumblr. 
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
